fusions.name: Thrown Blinkers
fusions.desc: Flicks a strip of cloth into the first enemy in line for 6 damage, with a 35% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Tangling Caparison
fusions.desc: Wheels about and lashes your caparison through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 13 damage, stunning everything in it for 1 second and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Loose Drape
fusions.desc: Conditions put on you have a 50% chance to be turned back on whoever cast them for 7 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Quilted Trapper
fusions.desc: Conjures a quilted trapper: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, and you move 4% faster.
